title: UL-11 — Challenge: API Gateway and Lambda
scenario: Add an authorized /admin route that returns 403 without credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul11`: HTTP API `workbook-ul11`, function `workbook-ul11`, role `workbook-ul11-lambda`, plus `workbook-ul11-auth` for a Lambda authorizer or user pool `workbook-ul11` for a Cognito JWT issuer if you use one. Tag each one LabId=ul-11.
HTTP API has public route GET /hello unchanged from guided pattern.
Second route GET /admin requires JWT or IAM authorization.
Authorized call returns 200 with expected body.
Lambda permissions allow only apigateway invoke from your API.
LabId=ul-11 tags on API and function.
No API keys committed to git.
CORS not wide open to * unless justified in notes.
Teardown deletes the API (this removes its authorizer, routes, integrations and stages).
Two routes documented in your notes.
stopChargesPanel: Delete the API (with its authorizer and routes), the Lambda functions and log groups, any Cognito user pool, and the IAM role for ul-11.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Lost track? List what is left: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-11
# delete-api removes the API's authorizers, routes, integrations and stages together
if ($ApiId -and $ApiId -ne 'None') { foreach ($Id in @($ApiId)) { if ($Id) { aws apigatewayv2 delete-api --api-id $Id } } }
$FnName = aws lambda get-function --function-name workbook-ul11-auth --query Configuration.FunctionName --output text
# Cognito: if you added a user pool domain, delete it first (aws cognito-idp delete-user-pool-domain)
if ($PoolId -and $PoolId -ne 'None') { foreach ($Id in @($PoolId)) { if ($Id) { aws cognito-idp delete-user-pool --user-pool-id $Id } } }

foreach ($P in (aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul11-lambda --query "AttachedPolicies[].[PolicyArn]" --output text)) { if ($P) { aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul11-lambda --policy-arn $P } }

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul11-lambda --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul11-lambda --policy-name $P } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-11 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws lambda get-function --function-name workbook-ul11 returns ResourceNotFoundException
aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-ul11-lambda returns NoSuchEntity
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-11 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-11. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-11) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
